title: 57th sitting of the 20th Majlis

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/57/2024).

Question by Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Finance, Moosa Zameer: why has the government stopped publishing the regular "Weekly Fiscal Developments" and "Monthly Fiscal Developments" reports on state revenue and expenditure, issued since November 2018, the last of which came out on 20 June?

First reading of a resolution submitted by Kendhoo MP Mauroof Zakir calling on the government to set a general grooming and dress-code standard for tourist resort and hotel workers, removing barriers employees face in wearing the hijab and keeping a decently trimmed beard and moustache.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Drugs Act (Law No. 17/2011), submitted on behalf of the government by Gan MP Yoosuf Nasheed.
Preliminary debate on the Attorney General's Office Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Maafannu South MP Abdulla Rifau.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled for a question to the Finance Minister on halted fiscal reports, first reading of a resolution on resort workers' dress codes, and opening debate on the Drugs Act amendment and the Attorney General's Office Bill.
